title: Pramaan Surveillance Evidence Format (SEF) Manifest
description: The manifest at the root of a SEF bundle. Published here so a third party can validate a bundle's structure without importing Pramaan at all -- the whole point of a 'standardized' interchange format is that it does not require this specific tool to check.

sef_version.description: SEF format version, independent of Pramaan's own package version.

ledger_filename.description: Path within the bundle to the audit-ledger excerpt, if one is included.

ledger_head_hash.description: The case ledger's head hash at export time -- lets a verifier confirm the included ledger excerpt matches what the case actually recorded, without needing the live case file.
